code-reviewer:
# Get the diff to review: every commit since the branch left origin/main
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_NAMESPACE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES && ref=$(git symbolic-ref -q refs/remotes/origin/HEAD || echo refs/remotes/origin/main) && base=$(git merge-base "$ref" HEAD) && git diff --stat "$base" HEAD && git diff "$base" HEAD
# Check for staged, unstaged and untracked changes too (ship commits them after this review)
git diff --cached
git diff
git ls-files --others --exclude-standard
# Understand the branch context
git log --oneline -5
security-auditor:
# Missing authorization checks
grep -rn "req\.user" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" | grep -v "authorize\|permission\|role\|isAdmin"

# Direct object references without ownership validation
grep -rn "params\.id\|params\.userId" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts"

# Weak hashing algorithms
grep -rn "md5\|sha1\|SHA1\|MD5" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" --include="*.py"

# Hardcoded secrets and keys
grep -rn "password\s*=\s*['\"]" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" --include="*.py" --include="*.env"
grep -rn "secret.*=.*['\"][A-Za-z0-9]" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts"

# SQL string concatenation
grep -rn "query.*\`.*\${\|query.*['\"].*+.*req\.\|execute.*['\"].*+" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts"

# Command injection
grep -rn "exec(\|execSync(\|spawn(\|child_process" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts"

# eval and dynamic code execution
grep -rn "eval(\|Function(\|setTimeout(['\"]" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts"

# Debug mode in production
grep -rn "DEBUG\s*=\s*[Tt]rue\|NODE_ENV.*development" --include="*.env" --include="*.config.*"

# Default credentials
grep -rn "admin:admin\|root:root\|password123\|changeme" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" --include="*.yml" --include="*.yaml"

# Verbose error messages exposed to client
grep -rn "stack.*trace\|err\.message\|error\.stack" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts"

# npm audit for known vulnerabilities
npm audit --json | jq '.vulnerabilities | to_entries[] | select(.value.severity == "critical" or .value.severity == "high")'

# Check for outdated packages
npm outdated --json

# Use dedicated tools for deeper analysis
npx snyk test
npx audit-ci --critical

# JavaScript/TypeScript -- high-risk patterns
grep -rn "eval(\|new Function(\|innerHTML\|outerHTML\|document\.write(" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx"
grep -rn "dangerouslySetInnerHTML" --include="*.jsx" --include="*.tsx"
grep -rn "child_process\|execSync\|exec(" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts"
grep -rn "\.raw\`\|String\.raw" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts"

# Python -- high-risk patterns
grep -rn "eval(\|exec(\|__import__\|pickle\.loads\|yaml\.load(" --include="*.py"
grep -rn "subprocess\.call.*shell=True\|os\.system(" --include="*.py"

# Secrets and credentials in source
grep -rn "PRIVATE.KEY\|BEGIN RSA\|BEGIN EC\|BEGIN OPENSSH" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" --include="*.py" --include="*.env"
grep -rn "api[_-]?key\|api[_-]?secret\|auth[_-]?token" -i --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" --include="*.env"

# Scan git history for leaked secrets
npx gitleaks detect --source . --verbose
npx trufflehog git file://. --only-verified

# Pre-commit hook to block secrets
# .pre-commit-config.yaml
# - repo: https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks
#   hooks:
#     - id: gitleaks

# Verify .env is gitignored
grep -q "\.env" .gitignore && echo "OK: .env in .gitignore" || echo "CRITICAL: .env NOT in .gitignore"

# Check if secrets were ever committed
git log --all --diff-filter=A -- "*.env" ".env*" "*secret*" "*credential*"

# Map the attack surface
tree -d -L 3 --gitignore
grep -rn "app\.\(get\|post\|put\|delete\|patch\)" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" | head -50

# Identify authentication boundaries
grep -rn "authenticate\|authorize\|isAuth\|requireAuth\|protect" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts"

# Check for .env and secrets exposure
ls -la .env* .gitignore
cat .gitignore | grep -i "env\|secret\|key\|credential"
performance-auditor:
# Find large bundle files and unoptimized images
find . -name "*.bundle.js" -o -name "*.chunk.js" | xargs ls -lhS 2>/dev/null | head -20
find ./public ./src -type f \( -name "*.png" -o -name "*.jpg" \) -size +200k

# Detect missing lazy loading in React
grep -rn "^import.*from.*components" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.jsx" | grep -v "lazy\|dynamic" | head -20

tree -d -L 3 --gitignore 2>/dev/null || find . -type d -maxdepth 3 | head -40
cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -30

grep -rn "for.*await.*query\|for.*await.*find\|forEach.*await" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" | head -20  # N+1
grep -rn "readFileSync\|writeFileSync\|execSync\|pbkdf2Sync" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts"              # Blocking
grep -rn "SELECT.*FROM" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" | grep -iv "LIMIT\|paginate\|cursor"              # No pagination
grep -rn "import.*from 'lodash'\|import.*from 'moment'" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts"                   # Heavy imports
find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o \( -name "*.bundle.js" -o -name "*.chunk.js" \) -print -exec ls -lh {} \;  # Bundle sizes
